defense_news.title: DARPA came close to finding a drone that can lift four times its own weight
defense_news.summary: In its recent Lift Challenge, DARPA came close to finding a drone that could lift four times its own weight.

defense_news.title: How US military funding propelled China’s robot dogs
defense_news.summary: Chinese company Unitree Robotics based the designs for its most successful robot dogs on innovations fueled by the U.S. military.

defense_news.title: US Army requests 133,000 GMLRS rockets by 2034
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army sent out a request this week for manufacturing 133,014 Guided Multiple Launch Rocket System, or GMLRS, rockets by 2034.

defense_news.title: US Air Force looks to acquire target drones that can mimic stealth jets
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Air Force wants to acquire target drones that can mimic the performance of a variety of aircraft, from stealth fighters to small UAVs.
